migration_groups.integration_point: Integrate the scheduler compatibility adapter before enabling its new reads.

requirements.text: Add the replacement time-zone representation before migrating readers.
Migrate account API and scheduler readers independently.
Remove the legacy representation only after all readers migrate.

coverage_ledger.reason: The expansion prerequisite adds the compatible representation.
The API and scheduler migration groups are independently mergeable.
Contraction waits directly for both migration groups.

tickets.title: Expand the time-zone representation
tickets.outcome: Both legacy and replacement time-zone representations are available.
in_scope: Add and verify the replacement representation.
out_of_scope: Migrate readers or remove the legacy representation.
acceptance: Old and new readers remain compatible after expansion.

tickets.title: Migrate account API readers
tickets.outcome: The account API reads the replacement time-zone representation.
in_scope: Move account API reads to the replacement representation.
out_of_scope: Migrate scheduler reads or remove legacy storage.
acceptance: Account API reads remain green using the replacement representation.

tickets.title: Migrate scheduler readers
tickets.outcome: The scheduler reads the replacement time-zone representation.
in_scope: Move scheduler reads to the replacement representation.
out_of_scope: Migrate account API reads or remove legacy storage.
acceptance: Scheduler reads remain green at the recorded integration point.

tickets.title: Contract the legacy time-zone representation
tickets.outcome: The legacy time-zone representation is removed after all readers migrate.
in_scope: Remove the legacy representation and compatibility path.
acceptance: No runtime reader uses the legacy representation.

consumes.output: Account API reads migrated to the replacement representation.
Scheduler reads migrated to the replacement representation.
